title: An AI Support System for a US Logistics Company
subtitle: Reading, understanding, and replying to support emails without a human touching most of them
blurb: Built an n8n workflow for a US logistics company that classifies incoming support emails, pulls answers from the client's own knowledge base, and drafts an on-brand reply in seconds.
result: Freed the support team from answering the same handful of questions every day, so they could focus on issues that actually need a human

meta.solutions: n8n, AI Email Classification, Knowledge Base Retrieval

whoFor: A logistics company whose support team was drowning in the same handful of repetitive questions every day: order status, refund policy, invoice requests.
challengeIntro: Most support tickets were the same five questions on repeat, order status, refund policy, where's my invoice, same questions, different customer, endless hours spent answering them by hand.
challengePoints: The same repetitive questions consumed most of the team's time
Replies relied on generic answers instead of the client's own knowledge base
No automatic classification to separate simple questions from ones that need a human
builtIntro: Built in n8n: every inquiry gets classified automatically (order issue, refund, general question), the AI pulls accurate answers from the client's own knowledge base rather than generic responses, and a professional, on-brand reply gets drafted or sent in seconds.
builtPoints: Automatic classification of every inbound inquiry
Answers sourced from the client's own knowledge base, not generic responses
On-brand reply drafted or sent within seconds
builtOutro: The support team stops answering the same question for the hundredth time and starts handling the conversations that actually need real problem solving.
